title: Detailed lollipop
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='stickGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f7f3e8'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e0d8c4'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id='candyRed' cx='35%' cy='30%' r='75%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8a8a'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#ff3b3b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c8102e'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='sheen' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <clipPath id='candyClip'>
      <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='30'/>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>

  <!-- stick -->
  <rect x='46' y='62' width='8' height='33' rx='4' fill='url(#stickGrad)'/>
  <rect x='46' y='62' width='3' height='33' rx='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <rect x='51' y='62' width='2' height='33' rx='1' fill='#cfc6b0' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- candy base -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='30' fill='url(#candyRed)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='30' fill='none' stroke='#ff9d9d' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- swirl pattern -->
  <g clip-path='url(#candyClip)'>
    <g fill='none' stroke='#fff4f4' stroke-width='4.5' stroke-linecap='round'>
      <path d='M50 38 C56 30 60 24 56 18 C52 12 42 14 40 22 C38 30 46 34 54 32 C64 30 68 20 62 12'/>
      <path d='M50 38 C44 46 40 52 44 58 C48 64 58 62 60 54 C62 46 54 42 46 44 C36 46 32 56 38 64'/>
      <path d='M50 38 C56 44 62 46 66 42 C70 38 68 30 60 28 C52 26 46 32 44 40'/>
    </g>
    <g fill='none' stroke='#ffd0d0' stroke-width='1.4' opacity='0.8'>
      <path d='M50 38 C56 30 60 24 56 18 C52 12 42 14 40 22 C38 30 46 34 54 32 C64 30 68 20 62 12'/>
      <path d='M50 38 C44 46 40 52 44 58 C48 64 58 62 60 54 C62 46 54 42 46 44 C36 46 32 56 38 64'/>
      <path d='M50 38 C56 44 62 46 66 42 C70 38 68 30 60 28 C52 26 46 32 44 40'/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- highlight sheen -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='26' rx='12' ry='8' fill='url(#sheen)'/>

  <!-- candy rim shine -->
  <path d='M28 52 A30 30 0 0 0 52 68' fill='none' stroke='#ffb3b3' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
